bio: Hi! My name is Andrew Dong, and I am a first-year in Canaday who plans to concentrate in Applied Math and Economics. I am from Iowa City, Iowa and enjoy bass fishing in my free time. At Harvard, you can find me in Cabot Science Library hanging out and studying with my friends!
